Alex: Quick sync — onboarding `artemis-16k-mqa` today. Need final weights path + tokenizer quirks noted for infra. RoPE scaling looks off on long sequences (see failing smoke). @Maria are the new shards live?
Maria: Yep. Weights are at `s3://redwood-models/artemis/16k/mqa/v1/weights.tar.zst` (sharded 8-way). Upload script in `infra/model-tools`. Tokenizer is byte-BPE with a whitespace normalization edge for CJK; we flip `normalize_whitespace` flag in tokenizer metadata now.
Jason: Ran a quick smoke with ~12k tokens, got a crash in attention: `IndexError: pos > max_pos` — stack points to `rope.py` when computing rotary indices. Minimal repro -> config used `max_position_embeddings: 16384` but runtime table only 8k.
Priya: Lint/validator note: serving config must ensure `pos_table_length >= max_seq_len` OR set `rope_scale`/`pos_embed: legacy`. For MQA variants we typically set `rope_scale: 0.5` to avoid overflow; I'll open a PR to prefer auto-adjust from model metadata.
Alex: Can we also add a validator rule to compare `tokenizer.vocab_size` vs `weights.tokenizer_size` so mismatches fail fast? That tripped us last week.
Maria: Agree. Also tokenizer fallback behavior currently replaces unknown tokens with `<unk>` which shifts offsets for downstream alignment — causing QA diffs. Suggest adding a pre-tokenize normalizer for CJK: `text = re.sub(r"\\s+", " ", text)` and a flag `preserve_offsets=True` in fallback.
Jason: Pushed runtime lint that warns when `rope_scale` doesn't match positional table length. Also added a default sliding-window of 2048 for MQA models to reduce KV-drift when clients send long continuity prompts.
deploy-bot: Canary started on `dedicated-canary-az4` for `artemis-16k-mqa` — 200 requests so far, p95=120ms, token-drop fallback events=24 (12%). Logs: `tokenizer_fallback triggered for 24 requests`.
Priya: Smoke script for others: `./scripts/smoke_onboard.sh artemis-16k-mqa s3://redwood-models/artemis/16k/mqa/v1/` — locally exit 0 for tokenization+serve check. On GCP canary saw p99 spike ~900ms on first prefix KV-miss.
Alex: Action items: Maria -> open tokenizer normalizer PR + update metadata; Jason -> add validator rule for `tokenizer_size` vs weights and confirm rope lint; Priya -> rollout plan + canary tolerances and include sliding-window config in playbook. I'll take QA coordination. If no blockers I'll mark this ready for dedicated rollout later today. :thumbsup:
Maria: On it, will ping when PRs link up.
Jason: I'll add unit tests for rope index calc and a quick fixture for >8k tokens.
Priya: Will document canary thresholds in the runbook.
Alex: Great — thanks everyone.
